name: Central Assistance For One Time Settlement Of Displaced Families From PoK And Chhamb Under Prime Minister's Development Package
benefit:
1. The applicant is provided with one-time financial assistance of ₹5,50,000 per displaced family.
1. The assistance consists of:

  - Central Government share: ₹5,49,692 per family.
  - State Government share: ₹308 per family.

1. The financial assistance can be used by displaced families for:

  - Running small businesses.
  - Undertaking scientific farming.
  - Undertaking livestock activities.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be the Claimant/Head of the Displaced Person (DP) family or his/her successor or heir residing within the State of Jammu & Kashmir. 1. The applicant should belong to the overall category of 36,384 displaced families. 1. The applicant should belong to any of the following categories: - Pakistan Occupied Jammu & Kashmir 1947 Displaced Persons. - Chhamb 1965 and 1971 (camp/non-camp) Displaced Persons.
